POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

4. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

7. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

11. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Developmen t of prisms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
